storage.value:
As a system user
I want to view penalties listing
So that I will be able to get information about penalties and perform operations

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Check system user permissions to view penalties listing

    1. Viewing penalties

      1. Allows to see all penalties in system

    2. Viewing deleted penalties

      1. Allows to see deleted penalties

  2. Should load list of all penalties in system

    1. By default it should display 25 records in one page with the possibility to change the number of displayed items in a page. Hardcoded values for dropdown: 25, 50, 100

  3. Total count of penalties should be loaded 

  4. Pagination 

    1. To be able to navigate through next /previous page

    2. To be able to navigate to first/last page

    3. To be able use arrow back/forward for navigation 

    4. To be able to go to a certain page from dropdown with available pages

    5. To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter will directly load that page

  5. In each row in a penalties list should load:

    1. ID

      1. unique identifier of penalties. System generates after creation

    2. Name

      1. Name of penalty

    3. Party receiving the penalty

      1. To display ENERGO-PRO Energy Services, Customer or both

    4. Applicability

      1. Contract, Points of Delivery, Event

    5. Group/Product/Service

      1. If penalty is not connected with Group/Product/Service, status is available. If penalty is connected with Group/Product/Service- should display name of this Group/Product/Service

    6. Date of creation

    7. Actions:

      1. Edit Group

      2. Delete Group

  6. To display loader while loading the list

  7. Search/filter penalties list:

    1. To be able to search penalties by predefined values:

      1. Penalty name

      2. Payment term name

    2. Min 1 character is required to enable search icon

      1. Empty search box state with gray search/clear search icon

    3. To be able to click on a search icon to run search when min 1 character is typed

    4. To display loader while loading search results

    5. To be able to select in which values to search for penalties

      1. All (By default)

      2. Penalties name

      3. Payment term name

    6. To be able to filter list by predefined filters; Each filter dropdown is multi select, it is possible to select more than one item:

      1. Party receiving the penalty

        1. ENERGO-PRO

        2. Customer

      2. Applicability

        1. Contract

        2. Points of Delivery

        3. Event

      3. Available

        1. YES

        2. NO

    7. It is possible to clear filter and keep search result

    8. It is possible to clear search result and keep filters

  8. Up/down arrows next to column title for sorting full list

    • ASC/DESC order

    • All columns should be sortable

  9. Create New penalty

    1. Clicking on it will open penalties creation page

  10. View penalty

    1. Clicking on a row will open penalty detail page, read only mode

  11. Edit penalty

    1. Edit icon will be always visible and active

    2. Clicking on edit icon will open penalty detail page in editing mode

      1. Edit operation is not always allowed on a penalty (check which penalty can’t be deleted will be implemented in Billing module)

  12. Delete penalty

    1. For deleting penalty user should have permission ‘Deleting penalty’

      1. If no, disable delete icon

      2. If yes, enable delete icon

    2. By clicking on a delete icon system should display warning message: 

      1. ‘Are you sure you want to delete the penalty?’

        1. YES – deletes penalty

          1. check if penalty can be deleted (check which penalty can’t be deleted will be implemented in Billing module) 

        2. Cancel– popup is closed and is not deleted

    3. Audit Log record should be created 

Filters /search logic

  1. Default state of filters/search

    1. List should be loaded

    2. Search/Clear search icon should be disabled

    3. All should be selected in search fields dropdown

    4. Search box should be empty

    5. filters should be unselected (grey border)

When user types search text in search box:

  1. Search /clear search icon should become active after typing 1 character

  2. List shouldn’t be filtered automatically (clicking on search icon will run search)

3 When user selects value in filters dropdown:

  1. Search /clear search icon should become active after selecting one option in filters dropdowns

  2. List shouldn’t be filtered automatically (clicking on search icon will filter)

  3. When value is selected in search field dropdown (filters is not selected and search text is not added)

  4. Search/Clear search icon should be disabled

  5. List shouldn’t be filtered automatically

  6. Clicking on a clear search icon should do following

  7. Filters should reset to to its default state (should unselect all values)

  8. Search text should be cleared

  9. All should be selected in search field dropdown

  10. Load initial state of list

Given that search text was added OR/AND filters were selected AND filtered
When user unselects all filters and clears search text (doesn’t matter in search field dropdown which value is selected)
Then Search /clear search icon should be disabled AND should Load initial state of list automatically 

  • Page orders in left Menu:

    1. Products

    2. Services

    3. Goods

    4. Price component

    5. Group of price components

    6. Terms

    7. Group of terms

    8. Interim & advance payment

    9. Group of Interim & advance payment

    10. Termination

    11. Group of terminations

    12. Penalty

    13. Group of penalties

    14. Price Parameter

  • Audit Log  

    • Audit Log record should be created on adding/Editing/Removing actions   

    • No need to create Audit Log record on Move to top/Drag & Drop 

  • Dark mode

    1. By default system’s color is light mode

    2. it is possible to switch system’s color to Dark mode by clicking on 'Dark Mode' icon in header; Clicking again will switch to light mode

  • Tab navigation

    • To be able to have keyboard navigation via tab, shift tab, Enter/space keys (left-right)

    • Disabled fields should be skipped
